scope: Independent source-bound adjudication of one conditional targeted Prism finding. Read-only, no code/test/GUI/Prism/Git changes.
rationale: Manual.Close calls enter(ctx,true), whose cleanup mode intentionally bypasses closed/application-lifetime rejection (manual_offscreen.go231-260). The noncancelled testContext and sequential calls admit cleanup; Close then returns nil immediately for closed=true (919-926).
A successful first Close sets closed and releases only its own process-wide active claim (935-942). The later cleanup call returns before touching any active successor, native window or owner.

NewManual claims the single process-wide active application before construction (147-179). The source-size test creates two Manual applications in one parent loop. Explicit Close after each iteration (grid_offscreen_test.go332) is necessary to release the first claim before the next NewManual; parent t.Cleanup callbacks run only after the whole test, so replacing explicit Close with cleanup would break the second iteration.

gridManual registers t.Cleanup (89-94) to close on early assertion exits. On successful iterations, its later sequential idempotent Close is deliberate. Existing full driver race gates execute this exact two-source loop and all cleanup callbacks; current correction does not change these semantics.
limits: Idempotence described for sequential Close with a valid noncancelled context; concurrent or canceled-context calls retain explicit admission/error contracts.
No new tests are needed to resolve the false conditional premise; no broader lifecycle changes.
